# SmarterTravel

> > SmarterTravel is a comprehensive travel advice and deals platform offering destination guides, budget tips, cultural etiquette, and curated travel deals for destinations worldwide, with a focus on Europe and North America.

The site features expert contributors like Kate H. Knapp, Patrick Gentemann, and The Deal Detective who provide practical travel advice, money-saving strategies, and destination-specific guides. Content ranges from detailed tipping guides and cultural etiquette to family-friendly itineraries and road trip inspiration.

## Key Topics

- Europe travel
- Budget travel tips
- Travel deals
- Travel etiquette
- Family travel
- Tipping guides
- Washington, D.C.
- Croatia
- Road trips
- Cultural customs
- TSA regulations
- International phone service
- Destination guides
- Money-saving strategies

## Travel Guides & Etiquette

- [Tipping in Croatia: The Croatia Tipping Guide](https://www.smartertravel.com/tipping-in-croatia-the-croatia-tipping-guide): Comprehensive guide to tipping etiquette and kuna gratuity in Croatia
- [Twenty-five tips for saving on Europe travel](https://www.smartertravel.com/twenty-five-tips-for-saving-on-europe-travel): 25 money-saving tips and budget advice for traveling in Europe
- [11 Things You Should Never Do in Australia](https://www.smartertravel.com/11-things-you-should-never-do-in-australia): Travel etiquette guide covering cultural mistakes to avoid in Australia
- [10 Tasty Snacks You Can Bring on the Plane](https://www.smartertravel.com/10-tasty-snacks-you-can-bring-on-the-plane): TSA-approved airplane snacks from Trader Joe's and budget travel tips
